name: Mad Monster Party Arizona
blurb: A horror, sci-fi and fantasy convention in Glendale with celebrity guests, autographs, elaborate movie-scene photo ops and tattoo artists.

editions.evidence: Madmonster.com's own global events menu lists 'July 9–11, 2027' as the Arizona show's next date. The dedicated Arizona page itself (same URL) has not been refreshed for that edition yet — it still shows the prior, already-concluded edition's own date ('July 10-12, 2026, RENAISSANCE PHOENIX GLENDALE HOTEL') and that edition's guest list (Tom Atkins, Warwick Davis, Linnea Quigley, etc.), so no guests or ticket link could be confirmed for the 2027 edition specifically.

notes: Mad Monster's site is inconsistent between pages: the homepage nav announces the next Arizona date as July 9-11, 2027, but the Arizona landing page content (guests, exact venue wording) is still the leftover page for the July 10-12, 2026 edition, which has already concluded. Venue/city/region are carried over from that most recent edition since no venue change has been announced; tickets is left blank because the only ticket link found (showclix 'mmpaz26') is explicitly for the 2026 show, not 2027. Guests is 'none-yet' because the only guest list visible belongs to the concluded 2026 edition, not the upcoming one.
